about: The guide's sidebar. groups: the sidebar headings in order. pages: one entry per page, file (a .md beside this file), title (the sidebar label) and group (one of groups; a group not listed there goes after the listed ones). A new page is one appended entry; pages show in the order of their group, then in the order they appear here. "hidden": true keeps a page reachable by link but out of the sidebar and the previous/next buttons.
